embeddedApps.exposure: Documents, spreadsheets, presentations and emails you work on, when Copilot or other connected experiences are used.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Turn off “Office content analysis” on the AI Protection page. In Microsoft 365 Personal or Family you can also open Word, Excel or PowerPoint, go to File › Options › Copilot, and clear Enable Copilot.

embeddedApps.exposure: Meeting audio and transcripts, chats and shared files.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: AI in work or school Teams is controlled by your organization's Microsoft 365 admin. In personal Teams, don't start recap or Copilot in meetings with sensitive topics.

embeddedApps.exposure: PDFs you open with AI Assistant and the questions you ask about them, processed in Adobe's cloud.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Turn off “AI Assistant in Adobe Acrobat” (and the Reader version) on the AI Protection page.

embeddedApps.exposure: Images and selections you use generative features on, processed in Adobe's cloud.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Generative features only send content when you use them. Avoid them on sensitive images, and review the privacy settings in your Adobe account.

embeddedApps.exposure: Meeting audio, video, chat and transcripts, used for summaries and smart recordings.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Sign in at zoom.us, open Settings, choose the AI Companion tab, and turn off the features you don't want. The meeting host decides whether summaries are created.

embeddedApps.exposure: Messages and files in channels you can see, used for summaries and search answers.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Slack AI is controlled by your workspace owner. Ask them, or check your workspace's admin settings.

embeddedApps.exposure: Meeting audio and transcripts, used for summaries and action items.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: The meeting host or your Webex admin controls AI Assistant. Check Webex's meeting settings before sensitive calls.

embeddedApps.exposure: Pages and databases in your workspace when you use AI features.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: In Notion, open Settings and look for the Notion AI section to manage AI features for your workspace.

embeddedApps.exposure: Designs, text and images you use Magic features on.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: In Canva, open Settings › Privacy settings and review whether your content can be used to train AI.

embeddedApps.exposure: Files you ask Dropbox AI to summarize or search, which may be processed by Dropbox's AI partners.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Sign in at dropbox.com, open your account settings, and review the AI-related options.

embeddedApps.exposure: The page you're on and anything you ask Aria, processed in Opera's cloud.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: In Opera, open Settings, search for “Aria”, and turn it off. You can also hide it from the sidebar.

embeddedApps.exposure: The page you're on and your questions, when you use Leo.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: Turn off “Leo AI in Brave” on the AI Protection page.

embeddedApps.exposure: Text you select and send to the AI chatbot provider you choose.
embeddedApps.howToTurnOff: In Firefox, open Settings, search for “chatbot”, and turn off the AI chatbot.
